observations: README representative English/Chinese, light/dark, 1440/768/390-width views preserve the intended source artwork and readable hierarchy. Chinese glyphs render with the recorded Noto CJK font. The long install command remains within a horizontally scrolling code block on narrow screens.
Representative authored conversation, bilingual long-content and asset views show usable spacing and readable Chinese text. These authored fixtures are distinct from the T1–T4 agent products.
Two temporal endpoint frames were actually viewed. This does not establish normal-speed video quality, intermediate-frame continuity, field performance or target-device smoothness.
limitations: Twelve selected still images were viewed, not every retained capture. All original captures, raw subprocess logs and two videos are archived. Full native conversation telemetry and resolved model/cost data are unavailable.
